FOLLOW-UP TO THE CURRENT REFERENCE-SCOPE REPAIR, NOT A BLOCKER ON 1363fd4.

Measured on the exact successor source: reference-scope.sh returns exit 0 with no gate command when changed module Scala sources contain no uppercase class, trait, object, enum, or type declaration. The regression court explicitly blesses a top-level def-only module source and a deleted declaration-free module source as no-types success. A public top-level def, val, or given can break downstream consumers, so this is a real false-success class even though the current Stage 1b candidate does not exercise it.

Future bounded repair: if the diff contains any changed Scala source under a recognized module shared or JVM root but declaration extraction yields no names, fail closed with a distinct nonzero exit and list exact module/path. Preserve exit 0 for Scala files outside recognized module roots such as docs examples. Name mutations for changed top-level def, deleted top-level def, top-level val/given, and docs-only control. Do not attempt heuristic consumer inference from lowercase names. Exact paths, after the current tool candidate resolves: tools/reference-scope.sh and tools/reference-scope-test.sh only.
set.title: reference-scope: fail closed on declaration-free module API changes
